contract_method: Declared constant inter-chromosome gap
implemented_method: Constant gap fixed at 20,000,000 bp, applied uniformly between adjacent autosomes
reason: M01 requires a declared constant but does not fix its value
expected_impact: Horizontal spacing only; no effect on any statistic or on point ordering

contract_method: Uniform order-statistic expectation, state convention if it differs from (i-0.5)/m
implemented_method: (i-0.5)/m used, i ascending in P over all m valid P values
reason: Contract default adopted; no deviation
expected_impact: None

contract_method: Finite positions and 0 < p_value <= 1; preserve qc_status; restore nothing
implemented_method: Filter applied as written; all 362,797 rows are autosomal, finite and valid, qc_status is uniformly PASS_DIRECTLY_GENOTYPED, so 0 rows were excluded
reason: No filtering was necessary on this snapshot
expected_impact: None

step: Join key between GWAS snapshot and Table 1 checkpoint
contract_method: Join exact aggregate frequency/count fields from DS_TABLE1_CHECKPOINT
implemented_method: Join executed on GRCh37 chr:position (the contract's own variant key), not on the display identifier, because DS_GWAS_CURRENT carries Illumina array probe IDs (e.g. GSA-rs146572333) while the checkpoint displays the bare rsID
reason: Display identifiers are not directly comparable between the two sources
expected_impact: None; rsID agreement is reported separately and matched for all 10 rows. The same dual convention is present in DS_LD_PRIMARY as lead_reference_id vs lead_summary_id

contract_method: Preserve variant_id for display and audit
implemented_method: A single leading 'TOKEN-' is stripped only when the remainder is itself a plain rsID; the unmodified source identifier is retained in column source_variant_id
reason: Required to render the submission's display identifier
expected_impact: Display only

contract_method: Missing values remain unclassified and must be logged
implemented_method: '<0.0001' (1 row, gnomAD_EUR_MAF for rs139129152) treated as a censored bound, not as missing; carried at its stated value and flagged
reason: A below-detection bound is informative for a ratio threshold, unlike a true missing
expected_impact: None; the audit table shows the East Asian enriched call is unchanged if the bound is instead treated as exactly zero

contract_method: A clump is the lead plus assigned member variants; do not reinterpret PLINK summary-bin counts as member counts
implemented_method: members_ref_ids lists non-lead members only and uses '.' for none, so the clump size was computed as 1 + len(members) and verified against n_variants_in_clump
reason: Convention confirmed empirically from the checkpoint
expected_impact: None; 17 leads + 9 members = 26 = Supplementary Table S1 row count

contract_method: At K = 100, 500, 1000, 2000 report matching-direction counts and proportions
implemented_method: M04 does not state which P orders the Top-K. Six readings were computed; the returned claim values are taken from DS_FIG3_PANEL_A as M04 designates
reason: Contract ambiguity resolved by evidence rather than assumption
expected_impact: Returned values are unaffected. In the optional rerun the closest reading is clump-by-European-P / rank-by-European-P, which reproduces every K to within one concordant variant (55/56, 279/280, 546/545, 1065/1064)

contract_method: EAS-LD clump by European P under the primary and four sensitivity settings
implemented_method: LD clumping implemented independently (no PLINK binary available): r2 is the squared Pearson correlation of ALT dosages in the 504-sample EAS panel, greedy assignment in ascending European P, window applied as a radius, ties broken by chromosome, position then normalized variant key. Only the PGEN format reader (pgenlib) is third-party
reason: No reference clumping implementation was available or consulted
expected_impact: Lead counts agree with the checkpoint to +5 / +2 / -2 / +9 / +7 across the five settings (relative 1.7e-05 to 1.0e-04). Attributable to tie order: the European P values take only 28,990 distinct values across 307,866 variants, so 97.4% of rows sit in tied groups and lead choice within a tie is convention-dependent

contract_method: Z = sum(sign*weight)/sqrt(sum(weight^2)), weight = -log10(European P clip 1e-300)
implemented_method: Implemented as written over the independently derived lead set
reason: Difference propagates from the lead set above
expected_impact: Z agrees to 0.029-0.154 absolute (0.97%-4.8% relative) across the five settings; sign, significance and the rank order of settings are unchanged, and every setting exceeds the one-sided alpha=0.05 reference in both the checkpoint and the rerun

contract_method: Not specified
implemented_method: 347 variants that carry a European P but are absent from the EAS reference panel were excluded from clumping rather than admitted as singleton leads
reason: A variant absent from the LD panel cannot be assessed for r2
expected_impact: Admitting them instead would add 347 leads and move the primary count away from the checkpoint (87,033 vs 86,681), so the exclusion rule is the supported one

contract_method: Aggregate control/model source
implemented_method: Rows 2-7 (the six fixed-threshold rows) carry 19 tab-separated fields against a 20-field header, so the trailing provenance text is parsed into control_pgs_sd_raw and provenance is empty for those rows
reason: Defect in the supplied file, not introduced by this reconstruction
expected_impact: None on any returned value: control_pgs_mean_raw and control_pgs_sd_raw were read from the optimized row (row 8), which has the full 20 fields and parses correctly. Reported for correction upstream

contract_method: 18 equal-width histogram bins
implemented_method: Bins span the observed case z range [z_min, z_max], not the 600-point KDE grid range
reason: M05 fixes the bin count but not the span; the observed-range reading is the one that reproduces the checkpoint
expected_impact: None; all 18 bin edges, counts and densities reproduce to 4.8e-10, the checkpoint's own stored decimal precision

contract_method: The optimized row is a secondary analysis
implemented_method: The optimized threshold was re-derived as the scan-wide maximiser of R2 over all 6,000 PRSice2 scan rows rather than taken from the checkpoint label
reason: Independent verification of a checkpoint-supplied value
expected_impact: None; the maximiser is unique and equals the checkpoint threshold 0.00640005

contract_method: Canonical interior crop x=201:1864, y=108:1264; log any differing crop
implemented_method: The canonical crop was used. Independent detection of the axes frame returns x=199:1867, y=106:1267 (deltas -2/+3 px on each side)
reason: The detector returns the frame including the drawn axis spine; the canonical crop is the interior strictly inside it
expected_impact: None; containment was verified for both panels and the canonical crop was used

contract_method: Rebuild a two-panel layout with live outer axes
implemented_method: The imshow extent was calibrated from the pixel extent of each checkpoint's own chance diagonal, which spans data (0,0)-(1,1), giving extent (-0.0488, 1.0495, -0.0483, 1.0473) and an implied axis margin of 0.0445
reason: Placing the axes rectangle as if it were the data rectangle would shift every curve inwards by the renderer's axis margin
expected_impact: Registration only. This measures the frame, not the ROC curve; no curve coordinate was traced, fitted or invented. Both panels calibrate identically

contract_method: Preserve all columns and missing-value representation
implemented_method: The source CRLF terminator was detected and reproduced
reason: So that byte identity is a meaningful check rather than being defeated by a line-ending convention
expected_impact: None; the reconstructed table is byte-identical to the source (SHA-256 equal)

step: Scope of the population-category row counts
contract_method: SUPPTABLE_S1_CATEGORY_COUNTS - 'Population-category row counts' over DS_TABLE_S1_CURRENT;DS_FIG2_FREQUENCY_CHECKPOINT
implemented_method: Counted over all 26 rows (8/12/6) rather than the 17 lead rows (5/7/5)
reason: Three pieces of contract evidence: FIG2_CATEGORY_COUNTS already returns the lead-only map 5/7/5 from the 17-row DS_FIG2_FREQUENCY_CHECKPOINT, so the lead-only reading would duplicate an existing claim; the matrix lists counting scope first and cross-check second throughout; and 8+12+6 = 26 = the sibling SUPPTABLE_S1_ROW_COUNT, whereas lead-only would sum to 17
expected_impact: The alternative breakdown is retained and returned as SUPPTABLE_S1_CATEGORY_COUNTS_LEAD_ROWS_ONLY so the custodian can substitute it without a recomputation

contract_method: M01 gives no instruction on excluding any variant below the suggestive line
implemented_method: All 27 variants with P < 1e-5 in DS_GWAS_CURRENT are plotted
reason: DS_GWAS_CURRENT carries 27 such variants while DS_TABLE_S1_CURRENT retains 26 rows; the one absent from Table S1 is rs376128944, and the Table S1 Notes cell for rs75790544 records it as a replacement lead for the WDHD1 locus after an rs376128944 exclusion. The exclusion is therefore documented in the payload but not instructed by M01, so applying it to the figure would require an instruction the contract does not give
expected_impact: No claim value is affected -- FIG1_VALID_VARIANTS, FIG1_LAMBDA_GC and the two thresholds are unchanged. The rendered Manhattan shows 27 points below the suggestive line where a 26-variant description would show 26

contract_method: M03 writes the labels lower-case: 'East Asian enriched', 'European enriched', 'similar frequency'
implemented_method: The emitted labels use the checkpoint capitalization 'Similar frequency'
reason: DS_FIG2_FREQUENCY_CHECKPOINT and DS_TABLE_S1_CURRENT both capitalize the middle label, so matching them keeps the category-agreement audit and the returned count maps on a single spelling. This alignment to the checkpoint spelling was made during implementation and is recorded here rather than left implicit
expected_impact: None on classification -- every row agrees on category under either spelling. The risk it carries is that grouping on the M03 spelling silently yields an empty middle category rather than an error

step: Checkpoint currency is not testable in scope
contract_method: M07: start from DS_TABLE_S1_CURRENT as the current source
implemented_method: Reconstructed from DS_TABLE_S1_CURRENT and verified against DS_LD_PRIMARY and DS_FIG2_FREQUENCY_CHECKPOINT only
reason: The v1.1 payload contains no submitted or published Supplementary Table S1, so whether DS_TABLE_S1_CURRENT is current with respect to the submitted table cannot be determined from the input package. Byte identity here establishes faithful reproduction of the payload checkpoint, not agreement with the submission
